description:
Conveniently pay your Sun Life insurance online using GCash with no charges at all! Avoid the hassle of waiting in the line just to pay your bills. 

How to do it:
1. Select "Pay Bills"option.
2. Choose "Insurance".
3. Select "Sun Life of Canada Phils".
4. Enter amount, account number, and email address (optional).
5. Confirm details. Double-check!

Then, wait for the confirmation of payment. You can do this in less than 2 minutes!

If you find this video helpful, leave a comment below. You can also suggest any instructional videos about #personalfinance. :)
